title: Postdoc and Faculty - Hangzhou, Zhejiang (CN) job with Zhejiang Chinese Medical University - Institute of Precision Medicine | 12866554
gist: A recruitment listing from the Institute of Precision Medicine at Zhejiang Chinese Medical University in Hangzhou, hiring postdocs through full professors and center directors across six research centers, including an Artificial Intelligence and Biotechnology Center, with start-up funding and postdoc pay around 320K RMB.

insights.claim: The Institute of Precision Medicine at Zhejiang Chinese Medical University in Hangzhou operates six research centers spanning translational medicine, cell therapy and cardiovascular disease, plus an Artificial Intelligence and Biotechnology Center and a Center for Efficacy and Safety Evaluation of Medicine.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Illustrates how Chinese institutions are pairing AI capability with cell therapy and drug-safety evaluation under one roof.
insights.locator: INSTITUTE OF PRECISION MEDICINE, is located

insights.claim: The institute is recruiting at every level from postdoctoral associate to full professor and center director, offering start-up funds and postdoc compensation of about 320K RMB.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: A datapoint on the pay and package levels China uses to staff precision-medicine capacity.

insights.claim: The institute is open to both Chinese and non-Chinese nationals and is recruiting globally for the Excellent Young Scientists Fund (Overseas) program with competitive compensation.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Evidence of active international talent recruitment into Chinese biomedical research, relevant to where capability accumulates.
insights.locator: we are also recruiting global talents
